from collections import Counter

with open("file.txt") as f:
    counts = Counter(line.rstrip("\n") for line in f)
for line, n in counts.most_common():
    print(f"{n:7d} {line}")

while getopts "v:f:" opt; do
  case "$opt" in
    v) VER="$OPTARG" ;;
    f) FILE="$OPTARG" ;;
  esac
done

instruction:
Convert this Bash trap to Python:

cleanup() { rm -f /tmp/lock.$$; }
trap cleanup EXIT
mkdir /tmp/lock.$$
output:
import os, tempfile

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="lock-")
os.close(fd)
try:
    # critical section
    pass
finally:
    os.unlink(path)

cat <<EOF > greeting.txt
Hello, $USER!
Today is $(date +%F)
EOF

user = os.environ.get("USER", "world")
open("greeting.txt", "w").write(
    f"Hello, {user}!\nToday is {date.today().isoformat()}\n"
)
